_comment: The country-by-country publisher research, as repo data rather than chat history. status is one of: wired (a collector reads this publisher's own feed), researched (the publisher is known and its stories arrive through a market sweep, but no direct feed of its own is read), refused (probed first-party and NOT usable, with the measured reason). Every refusal was measured at least twice from a machine with real egress. Rendered publicly by railway/generate_source_catalogue.py.
